question: Who among the following became the fastest athlete at the Khelo India Youth Games 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ancy Sojan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ancy Sojan** became the fastest athlete at the Khelo India Youth Games 2020.
 
• Ancy Sojan claimed the under-20 men and women's 200m crowns respectively on the final day of the 36th National Junior Athletics Championships on 10 Feb 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Khelo India Youth Games 2020 was held in Guwahati.
 
• Winner - Maharashtra
 
• The champions trophy was handed over to Maharashtra, the first runner-up trophy to Haryana, and the second runner-up trophy to Delhi.
 
• Khelo India Youth Games is an annual event.
 
• The first edition was held in 2018 in Delhi.
 
• The second edition was held in Pune, Maharashtra.
